outputs.explanation: Panel A shows whole-lung bright-field and fluorescence photographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Bar graph of mean ICG fluorescence intensity ± SD with individual data points (blue and red dots for each mouse) overlaid on the bars.
Panel C includes micrographs (H&E, ICG, RNAscope) and spatial expression heatmap-style plots (Cd68, Spp1 log2 expression on spatial spots); heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Bar graph showing log2 fold change of M2/TAM genes has no individual data points overlaid on the bars, only summary bars with p-values annotated.
Panel F shows fluorescence and IHC micrograph/photograph images, not a plot of averaged data.
